description: Validate a UiSchema or render it as static HTML/fragments. Use it when checking schema/patch contracts or exporting static output; use design_preview for a running React/Vue app, code_generate for file sets, or schema_store for persistence. Returns validation diagnostics or rendered output with warnings and artifact references. action selects validate/render; mode selects full schema or patch, with schemaRef available for reuse. Render defaults to a document with token CSS; output.compact omits CSS. brand and output scope options affect documents; ignored fragment options are diagnosed. apply:true emits render artifacts; output.payloadMode:file writes payloads and returns paths, as does an oversized document unless inline. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#schema_render; full schema: oods://schemas/schema_render.input.json.

action.description: Selects the per-action handler. 'render' -> repl.render, 'validate' -> repl.validate.

apply.description: For render: When true and the schema validates, render it: the HTML document in html, or per-node fragments with output.format 'fragments'. Actions: render, validate. See full schema for details.

baseTree.description: Required when mode='patch' to provide the base UiSchema to patch. Actions: render, validate.

brand.description: Brand to render. Actions: render. See full schema for details.

mode.description: Full schema or patch mode. Actions: render, validate.
